1.w: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down and we wept in our remembering Zion.

2.w: Upon the willows in her midst, we hung our harps.

3.w: For there our captors required of us the words of a song, and our tormentors, joy: “Sing to us a song of Zion.”

4.w: How can we sing a song of YHWH in a foreign land?

5.w: If I should forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand forget.

6.w: May my tongue cling to my palate, if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem above my chief joy!

7.w: Remember, O YHWH, about the sons of Edom, on the day of Jerusalem—those saying, “Lay [her] bare! Lay [her] bare to her foundation!”

8.w: O Daughter of Babylon, O destroyed one, blessed [is] he who repays to you, dealing with you as you have dealt with us!

9.w: Blessed [is] he who seizes and dashes your infants against the rock!
